title: Accurately Tilled Farmland
description: This Resource Pack adds connectivity to the farmland block to make it seem more realistic, because who tills the ground using a ruler?
body:
**This pack has taken inspiration from** [**Stardew Valley**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/413150/Stardew_Valley/)**, where tilling the soil is randomly generated and natural.**

In minecraft the farmland looked too sharp and non-farm like. This pack makes farmland next to grass and dirt have it connected, other blocks make farmland blocks behave normally.

![Dirt, Grass, Farmland (Wet)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b09ef0f74bef38e959e09239ef4b5395cc79844c_0.webp)
_In all showcase pictures are used: [Photon Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/photon-shader) and [(Bee's) Fancy Crops](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-crops)_
